title: papaver pilosum subsp. sparsipilosum
intro: Papaver pilosum subsp. sparsipilosum, commonly known as Himalayan poppy, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the poppy family (Papaveraceae). The plant is traditionally used in medicine due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antispasmodic properties, making it useful for treating conditions such as pain, wounds, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Papaver pilosum subsp. sparsipilosum include analgesia, anti-tussive, and expectorant effects, which can help alleviate coughs and congestion. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids like protopine, allocryptopine, and sanguinarine, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
